LanguageData.HD_ContentUsage_HD_CrowsComputer: Supply power and link the computer to one CROWS II station on the same map. Linking installs its controls. Both buildings need electricity, and the weapon fires only while a colonist operates the computer.
LanguageData.HD_ContentUsage_HD_Building_CrowsII: After construction, choose an M2HB, Mk 19, M240B or M249. A builder brings the additional materials and mounts it. Supply ammunition and power, link a computer and assign its operator. An empty station cannot aim, fire or accept ammunition.
LanguageData.HD_ContentUsage_HD_InstalledBreachCharge: Attach the charge to a wall or door and assign a nearby operator to detonate it. It removes the target structure and directs blast suppression and fragments through the breach. Charge strength beyond the target’s remaining health does not become additional structural damage.
LanguageData.HD_ContentUsage_HD_RotaryDrill: Completed wells have 100–130% quality. The rig consumes diesel only while drilling and stops when it needs a colonist to service it. After development, dismantle the rig and install a pump jack over the developed field.
LanguageData.HD_ContentUsage_HD_TelegraphTable: A wired terminal for contacting LOW Helod companies and organizations. Request financial, industrial, arms and hunting, or petroleum caravans, arrange Pioneer Overseas Service Company forward-base contracts, and hire Harrington Protective Services guards. Caravan requests require financial reputation. After construction, request paid line installation from a visiting LOW Helod caravan; the line opens in 2–3 days. Expand faction and company rows while the relay is open, from 08:00 to 18:00 local time. Transmissions use primary cells.
LanguageData.HD_ContentUsage_HD_Radio: An upgraded wireless terminal for all LOW Helod company services, including caravan requests, loans, forward-base contracts and security. Power replaces wired installation and primary cells, with frequencies available around the clock. Colonists can also chat with LOW and HIGH HAM operators or listen to broadcasts during recreation.
LanguageData.HD_ContentUsage_HD_TCCC_HemostaticAgent: Load the dose into a large medical pouch and administer it through the TCCC menu. Administration takes 1 second and reduces systemic bleeding by 70% for 6 hours. It can accompany body-part hemostasis. Blood pumping is reduced by 10% and consciousness by 5%; it does not heal wounds or replace lost blood.
